<action type="say">
I can start a return for you.

To pull up the right order, I need one of the following:
- Order ID, or
- Email + shipping ZIP code (and, if possible, last 4 digits of the card used)

Also tell me:
- Which item(s) you want to return (if multiple were in the order)
- The quantity for each
- Why you’re returning them (e.g., too big, damaged, changed mind)
- Whether you prefer dropoff or pickup, if both are available

Share what you have, and I’ll take it from there.</action>

<action type="say">
The system I’m connected to won’t let me look up orders by date/email/ZIP—it’s currently requiring the exact order ID, so I can’t directly pull up your order with what we have now.

The quickest way to get the order ID is usually:
- Check your confirmation email for that Electronics Kit (subject often like “Your order confirmation”); look for “Order #” or “Order ID”.
- Or, if you have an account on the store’s site, go to Orders / Order history and open the October 19, 2025 order to see the ID.

If you paste that order ID here, I can:
1) Verify the Electronics Kit on the order,
2) Confirm it’s eligible for return,
3) Create a dropoff return with reason “Changed my mind / not needed”,
4) Then give you the return confirmation and refund details.

If you’re unable to find the ID at all, you’ll need to contact the store’s customer support directly so they can search by email/ZIP/date in their internal system.</action>
